'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian conflict (2024–present)|Syrian conflict]]
**[[Western Syria clashes]]
***At least three people are killed and dozens of others are injured after gunfire erupts during [[Alawites|Alawite]]-led protests in [[Latakia]], [[Syria]], demanding [[decentralization]] and for the [[Syrian transitional government|transitional government]] to release [[Assadist]] detainees. [https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/three-dead-alawite-protests-syrian-coast-local-officials-say-2025-12-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israel]] introduces new rules for [[aid organization|aid group]]s, forbidding activities or criticism that [[Legitimacy of the State of Israel|"delegitimizes" Israel]], without providing specific definitions. Aid groups say that the requirements are political and may hinder [[criticism of Israel]]'s actions in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-12-29/aid-agencies-fear-lifesaving-program-blockage-into-gaza-/106181964 (ABC News)]
*[[Ecuadorian security crisis]]
**Six people, including a two-year-old girl, are killed and three others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a beach in [[Puerto López]], [[Manabí Province]], [[Ecuador]]. [https://www.lanacion.com.ar/agencias/ecuador-ataque-a-resort-turistico-al-menos-6-muertos-entre-ellos-una-nina-nid28122025/ (''La Nación'' <small> in Spanish</small>)] [https://www.trtworld.com/article/3253ae8528b0 (TRT World)]

'''Arts and culture'''
* After months of a [[NewJeans#2024–present:_Conflict_with_Hybe,_hiatus,_and_Danielle's_departure|high-profile legal dispute]], entertainment agency [[Hybe|ADOR]] terminates its contract with singer [[Danielle Marsh|Danielle]] and expels her from the [[South Korea]]n [[girl group]] [[NewJeans]]. [https://www.the-independent.com/arts-entertainment/music/news/ador-newjeans-danielle-marsh-contract-terminated-b2891490.html (''The Independent'')] [https://koreajoongangdaily.joins.com/news/2025-12-29/national/socialAffairs/NewJeans-agency-ADOR-cuts-off-member-Danielle-warns-legal-measures-against-her-familys-responsibility-for-the-conflict/2488289 (''Korea JoongAng Daily'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Oaxaca train derailment]]
**At least 13 people are killed and 98 others are injured, including five critically, when a [[Tren Interoceánico]] train carrying 250 people derails in [[Asunción Ixtaltepec]], [[Oaxaca]], [[Mexico]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/least-13-dead-after-train-derails-mexico-2025-12-29/ (Reuters)] [https://www.infobae.com/mexico/2025/12/28/tren-interoceanico-gobernador-de-oaxaca-reporta-15-heridos-tras-el-descarrilamiento/ (Infobae <small>in Spanish</small>)]
*Sixteen people are killed and three others sustain burn injuries after a fire breaks out at a [[retirement home]] in [[Manado]], [[North Sulawesi]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-fire-kills-16-people-retirement-home-2025-12-29/ (Reuters)]
*Three people, including a toddler, are killed and three others are injured when a building collapses in [[Soweto]], [[Gauteng]], [[South Africa]]. [https://apnews.com/article/south-africa-building-collapse-three-dead-66df10b356572c092dc132f293e57181 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Richelieu stabbing]]
**Nine people are killed, including five children, and three others are injured, including the perpetrator and another child, in a [[Spree killer|mass stabbing spree]] at multiple houses in Richelieu, [[Commewijne District]], [[Suriname]]. [https://apnews.com/article/suriname-knife-attack-children-7485dabfe9e7939b490b726c942c0af2 (AP)]
*[[Capital punishment in Iraq]]
**The [[Supreme Iraqi Criminal Tribunal]] sentences a former [[Ba'athist Iraq|Ba'athist]] lieutenant to death for the massacre of [[Barzani (tribe)|Barzanis]] during the [[Anfal campaign]] against [[Kurds]]. [https://thenewregion.com/posts/4090 (''The New Region'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025–26 Myanmar general election]]
**Citizens of [[Myanmar]] vote in the first phase to elect the nation's [[Pyidaungsu Hluttaw|legislature]]. Two further phases of voting are expected in January. [https://apnews.com/article/myanmar-election-yangon-suu-kyi-hlaing-military-f361d4962d30b9c5c4741110bb1271ef (AP)]
*[[2025 Central African general election]]
**Citizens of the [[Central African Republic]] vote to elect a [[List of heads of state of the Central African Republic|president]] and 140 members of the [[National Assembly (Central African Republic)|National Assembly]]. Incumbent president [[Faustin-Archange Touadéra]] seeks a third term in office. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/central-african-republic-votes-russia-ally-touadera-seeks-third-term-2025-12-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[2025 Guinean presidential election]]
**[[Guinea]]ns vote for a [[President of Guinea|president]] as incumbent [[Mamady Doumbouya]] seeks to be elected four years after leading a [[2021 Guinean coup d'état|coup]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/guinea-votes-presidential-election-expected-cement-doumbouyas-rule-2025-12-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[December 2025 Kosovan parliamentary election]]
**[[Kosovo|Kosovans]] vote for the second time in a year to elect the members of the [[Assembly of the Republic of Kosovo|Kuvendi]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/kosovo-heads-snap-vote-end-political-deadlock-128716540 (AP via ABC News)]
**[[Prime Minister of Kosovo|Prime Minister]] [[Albin Kurti]]'s [[Vetëvendosje]] party wins the election with about half of the votes and an estimated 56 of the 120 assembly seats but falls short of the 61 seats required to govern without support from [[List of political parties in Kosovo|minority parties]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/28/kosovo-votes-in-snap-election-to-end-a-year-of-political-deadlock (Al Jazeera)]
